title: Consumer Psychology
summary: Consumer psychology: decision-making, persuasion, advertising, consumer behavior, and psychological factors in purchasing.
revision: Consumer psychology: decision-making, persuasion, advertising, consumer behavior. Editorial enrichment — no source coverage.
traps: Consumer psychology = purchase decisions and behavior.
Decision stages: need recognition → search → evaluation → purchase → post-purchase.

notes.t: The study of why people buy, how they make purchase decisions, and how marketing and advertising influence consumer behavior.

i: Need recognition: perceiving a gap between actual and desired state
Persuasion: changing attitudes and behavior through communication
Advertising: paid promotion influencing consumer choice
Brand attitudes: consumer evaluation of brands

notes.t: UGC NET may ask about consumer decision-making and persuasion.

mnemonics.title: NIEPP
mnemonics.text: N — Need recognition (gap perception), I — Information search (seek info), E — Evaluation (compare options), P — Purchase (select/buy), P — Post-purchase (evaluate)

flashcards.a: Why people buy and purchase decisions.
